// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-UNPROJECTED-READ
// A relation selected with `true` returns whole rows of the RELATED model. The
// outer call has a select:, staff points at an adult model so it is not a child
// relation, and every rule was satisfied while this returned every teacher's
// password hash.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function schoolsWithStaff() {
  return db.school.findMany({ select: { id: true, name: true, staff: true } });
}
